description: This file defines a utility function 'fetchActiveUsersByBucket' that wraps an API call to fetch active user trend data, mapping UI bucket granularity to backend parameters and handling date range parameters. It also exports this function as part of a default object.

methods.name: fetchActiveUsersByBucket(bucket, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches active user trends based on specified granularity ('daily', 'weekly', 'monthly') and optional date and status parameters, translating UI buckets into backend granularity and calling the 'fetchActiveTrend' API function.
